title: Identity and composition equations of integral scalar duality comparisons
statement: Fix D,l,E⊂L,X and coherent dualizing data wE,wL, and any normalized tensor-Hom presentations a,b [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] whose evaluation counits are natural in the first tensor variable. The prescribed u,v,beta and the completion-conjugated unit/comp maps [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core] satisfy IdentityConclusion for E and L, and CompositionConclusion for every further finite coefficient extension L→F, coherent dualizing datum wF and normalized tensor presentation c with the same first-variable evaluation naturality. These are the three comparison composition equations, the two associator unit equations and the associator pentagon on actual ambient maps. No isomorphism, finite reduction or double-dual assertion is included.

proof.text: The scalar unit is multiplication and comp sends c tensor (b tensor x) to c*j(b) tensor x. Three successive coefficient multiplications agree on pure tensors, proving the unit and pentagon equations. The completion comparisons cancel at intermediate vertices and localization retains the equations.

Finite dualizing counit transposes satisfy the unit and cocycle equations by pasting compact-support scalar comparisons and exceptional counits. Pass through coherent total limit; the prescribed finite reductions and u_existsUnique identify the resulting maps with u.

Transpose the v composites after the same scalar associator. Both transposes are scalar extension of evaluation, giving equality. Postcompose with Hom into the u equation to get beta. Identity extension uses the identical calculation with multiplication as scalar unit. Representative normalization makes this independent of presentations and of basis choices.
